s.how: Bring 150g each of aged cheddar, brie and goat's cheese to room temperature. Arrange on a wooden board with bunches of red grapes, a pot of fig jam, toasted walnuts and a stack of crackers. Serve with the vineyard view.

Mix 450g self-raising flour with 300ml cream and 300ml lemonade until just combined. Pat out, cut into rounds and bake close together at 220C for 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with strawberry jam and clotted cream.

m.note: the twins recreating their parents' first date dinner
m.how: Layer thinly sliced potatoes with cream and bake at 180C for an hour. Roast a 1kg beef eye fillet to medium-rare and rest. Deglaze the pan with red wine and stock and reduce until glossy. Serve with green beans by candlelight on a boat.

w.note: the London twin's pudding, strawberries and cream
w.how: Hull 500g strawberries. Blitz 100g of them with 1 tbsp sugar into a sauce and quarter the rest. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks, fold in 6 broken meringue nests and the quartered strawberries, spoon into 4 glasses and drizzle with the sauce.

d.n: Napa Valley grape and rosemary spritz
d.how: Simmer 60g caster sugar, 60ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. Freeze a bunch of red grapes for 2 hours. Mix 600ml chilled red grape juice with the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lime. Drop frozen grapes into 4 wine glasses, pour in the juice and top each with 80ml sparkling water. Finish with a small rosemary sprig.
